title: How a Sports Team Grew Ticket Sales by Running Prospecting and Retargeting as One Play
summary: The post How a Sports Team Grew Ticket Sales by Running Prospecting and Retargeting as One Play appeared first on MNTN .
body_markdown:
Every empty seat at a live event is lost revenue, whether a venue, a promoter, or a team is selling the tickets. And a ticket has a hard expiration date. A pair of shoes can sit in a cart for a month and still sell; a seat is worth nothing once the game starts. That deadline raises the stakes on every part of the funnel, and it means the pool of people who’ve shown interest needs refilling far more often than it would for a typical retailer.


Owned channels like email do reliable work with fans who are already paying attention. The bigger opportunity is the much larger group who’d show up if they knew about the game, and those people live outside the list. To fill its venue, the team needed a strategy that widened its audience and measured that reach in ticket revenue, not impressions.
